author: Nate Miller
title: Jhoan Duran picks up another save
desc: Jhoan Duran retired all three batters he faced during the ninth inning to pick up a save in Saturday's 4-2 win over the Tigers.
impact: Duran earned his 24th save of the season Saturday, putting him in a three-way tie atop the NL leaderboard. The flamethrowing righty is sporting an elite 1.38 ERA and 0.92 WHIP with 50 strikeouts through 32 2/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Cristopher Sanchez rebounds with solid effort
desc: Cristopher Sanchez surrendered two runs on 10 hits and one walk while striking out seven over seven innings in Saturday's 4-2 win against the Tigers.
impact: After enduring one of the worst outings of his career this past Monday, Sanchez got back on track Saturday. The All-Star lefty improved to 11-4 through 20 starts, now boasting a 2.62 ERA while ranking third in the league with 144 strikeouts across 127 1/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Reynaldo Lopez done in by rough first inning Saturday
desc: Reynaldo Lopez allowed four runs on five hits and one walk while striking out three over five innings in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: Coming in off a pair of solid outings, Lopez made one big mistake in Saturday's start, serving up a three-run homer to Lars Nootbar with two outs in the first frame. Lopez went on to give up just one additional run across the next four innings, but the Braves' bats were unable to bail the righty out. Lopez has been pitching well for the most part since rejoining the Braves' rotation, but he's yet to bo beyond five innings in four turns.

author: Nate Miller
title: Mauricio Dubon smacks solo homer in Saturday's loss
desc: Mauricio Dubon went 1-for-4 with a solo homer in Saturday's 4-1 loss to the Cardinals.
impact: The Braves offense has suddenly disappeared again in St. Louis the last couple of nights, but Dubon continues to produce. The versatile veteran has tied his career high in home runs with his 10th of the season on Saturday, and he's already been building on a career mark in RBI. Dubon has hit an even .300 with 22 RBI over 34 games since the beginning of June.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Yoendrys Gomez logs clean inning in Twins' 5-3 win
desc: Yoendrys Gomez worked around a little traffic but did his job and earned the save without drama in a 5-3 win over the Angels on Saturday.
impact: Yoendrys Gomez allowed zero earned runs on one hit and one walk while striking out one over one inning in Saturday's win over the Angels. After the outing, he owns a 3.50 ERA and 1.26 WHIP with a 1-0 record, 11 saves, 7.8 K/9, and a 1.90 K:BB across 39 appearances.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Royce Lewis goes deep, drives in two in 5-3 win
desc: Royce Lewis went 2-for-4 in a 5-3 win over the Angels with a home run, a double, two runs scored, two RBI, and one strikeout.
impact: Lewis delivered some much-needed thump while continuing to live in the three-true-outcomes neighborhood. After Saturday's win, Lewis is batting .221 with 10 home runs, 29 RBI, 30 runs scored, and six stolen bases across 62 games. He's hitting .286 with two homers and six RBI over his past seven contests.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Joe Ryan mostly steady, but no decision in 5-3 win
desc: Joe Ryan allowed two earned runs on six hits and two walks while striking out six over six innings in Saturday's 5-3 win over the Angels.
impact: He now owns a 2.85 ERA and 1.05 WHIP with a 6-5 record through 20 starts, alongside a 10.4 K/9 and 5.12 K/BB. He will now prepare to take part in his second consecutive All-Star game on July 14.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brandon Williamson (shoulder) to throw bullpen session Sunday
desc: Brandon Williamson is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Sunday.
impact: Williamson has been sidelined since April 30 due to left shoulder fatigue. Although he had progressed to a throwing program, it was temporarily paused after he suffered a finger injury during a workout. His finger has since healed, and he is scheduled to throw a bullpen session on Sunday. However, he remains without a clear timeline for a return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Blake Dunn (elbow) hits off tee Saturday
desc: Blake Dunn hit off a tee on Saturday.
impact: Dunn received a cortisone injection in late June to address lingering elbow discomfort. He has shown improvement in recent days and hit off a tee for the first time since being sidelined. However, he remains without a clear timeline for a return.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Petey Halpin chips in despite K-heavy night in 4-1 win
desc: Petey Halpin went 1-for-4 in a 4-1 win over the Marlins with a run scored, one stolen base, and three strikeouts.
impact: After Saturday's win over Miami, Halpin is batting .172 with 10 hits (including one double and one triple), one RBI, nine runs scored and three steals across 30 games.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Steven Kwan chips in double, swipe as Guardians top Marlins
desc: Steven Kwan went 1-for-4 in a 4-1 win over the Marlins on Saturday with a double, two RBI, and one stolen base.
impact: Kwan has been muddling through a tough season at the plate, but he's starting to show signs of life, hitting .279 over his past 15 contests while playing elite defense in the outfield. After Saturday's win over Miami, Kwan is slashing .221/.330/.279 with one home run, 16 RBI, 37 runs scored, and five stolen bases across 88 games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tommy Troy suffers shoulder injury Saturday
desc: Tommy Troy exited Saturday's game against the Los Angeles Dodgers in the fifth inning due to a right shoulder contusion.
impact: Troy sustained the injury after crashing into the center-field wall while making a running catch. He is considered day-to-day, with an update on his status potentially coming before Sunday's series finale.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Gabriel Arias pads the box score in win on Saturday
desc: Gabriel Arias went 3-for-4 in a 4-1 win over the Marlins on Saturday with one run scored, two stolen bases, and one strikeout.
impact: Arias has been posting quality production for the Guardians of late, hitting .353 with two homers, four RBI, and two steals over his past seven contests. After Saturday's win, Arias is batting .239 with five home runs, 10 RBI, 10 runs scored, and three steals across 30 games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tony Santillan (oblique) receives PRP injection Thursday
desc: Tony Santillan received a PRP injection on Thursday.
impact: Santillan has been sidelined since June 23 due to a left oblique strain. He received a PRP injection to help speed up the healing process and continues to undergo treatment. However, he remains without a clear timeline for a return.

author: Matthew Adam
title: Colin Holderman logs first save in tidy 11-pitch outing
desc: Colin Holderman threw a scoreless inning on 11 pitches to earn the save in Saturday's 4-1 win over the Marlins.
impact: With Cade Smith unavailable after pitching on each of the previous three days, Holderman was given his first save chance of the year and didn't complicate it. After Saturday's win, Holderman now has a 1.78 ERA and 0.85 WHIP with one save, zero blown saves, and eight holds across 35 appearances.
